newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian lira more or less at right level - Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Italian lira more or less at right level - Fazio.

text.p: The current exchange rate for the Italian lira is more or less correct, Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Thursday.
"The exchange rate is not especially out of kilter," Fazio said, replying to a question from the lower house of parliament's budget commission.
The lira has strenghtened sharply in recent weeks and is now holding just below the 1,000 level against the German mark.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi last week called for talks to start as soon as possible to fix a level for the lira's re-entry to the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM). -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
